in_sanskrit.name: विलाश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The source of joy, the one who brings happiness and delight.

in_hindi.name: विलाश
in_hindi.meaning: विविध रूपों से प्रकट हुए आनंद, खुशियों का स्वरूप
in_hindi.long_meaning: The manifestation of various forms of joy and happiness, the embodiment of delight and pleasure.

in_tamil.name: விலாஷ
in_tamil.meaning: விழந்து, காலை, அவைகள் அல்லவியல் பெற்ற அவர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who brings delight and joy, the one who receives the fruits of one's labor, the one who experiences pleasure.

in_telugu.name: విలాశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is delighted, the one who is the source of delight, the one who experiences happiness and pleasure.

in_marathi.name: Vilash
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Beauty, merriment, joy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vilash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who brings beauty, merriment and joy

in_bengali.name: Vilash
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Beauty, merriment, joy
